world_org_meetings.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy speaks at EU summit amid spat with Donald Trump
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders reaffirmed support for Ukraine at the Brussels summit. But souring relations with the US over Russia and Starlink and a big hole in the budget will make for a difficult winter for Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: Zelensky hails "real leaders" in Europe, blasts Trump's diesel deal with Russia
world_org_meetings.description: Ukrainian ​President Volodymyr Zelensky took aim on Friday at US President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia and welcomed the prospect of European allies stepping up their role in talks, calling Moscow's stance a "parody" of peace negotiations. At a European Union summit in Brussels, Zelenskiy said Russia did not want peace. He added that Ukraine was still experiencing disruptions to the SpaceX Starshield satellite system. FRANCE 24's Europe Editor Armen Georgian reports from Brussels.

world_org_meetings.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 finance ministers, central bankers gather amid fallout from Iran war
world_org_meetings.description: Officials meet in Thailand as conflict drives energy prices higher and casts uncertainty over global economy.

world_org_meetings.title: Burnham to push for new post-Brexit deals at EU summit
world_org_meetings.description: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the prime minister was "unpicking" the deal the UK signed with the EU.

diplomatic_visits.title: Rubio arrives in Samarkand as Washington seeks closer ties with Central Asia
diplomatic_visits.description: The US secretary of state will meet the foreign ministers of five Central Asian countries on Monday under the C5+1 format. Trade, investment, critical minerals and security are expected to feature in discussions, while more than 200 American business executives accompany the visit.

diplomatic_visits.title: Hungarian PM Péter Magyar says Zelenskyy unlikely to visit Budapest later this month
diplomatic_visits.description: Zelenskyy's deputy chief of staff told Euronews earlier this week that the Ukrainian leader had been invited to Budapest on 23 October, to join events commemorating the 70th anniversary of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution.

diplomatic_visits.title: Why Marco Rubio’s visit to Mumbai has ruffled feathers in India
diplomatic_visits.description: US secretary of state is skipping New Delhi, and opposition leaders complain his arrangements are humiliating.

diplomatic_visits.title: Chile president makes first state visit to Bolivia in 71 years as region shifts right
diplomatic_visits.description: Chile’s president is in Bolivia for the first state visit by a Chilean leader in more than seven decades

diplomatic_visits.title: REPLAY: Ukraine's Zelensky holds presser in Brussels
diplomatic_visits.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Friday urged European leaders to maintain their support for Kyiv and warned against easing sanctions on Russia. Speaking to reporters at the European summit in Brussels, Zelensky said that ending the war remained Ukraine’s priority but accused Russian President Vladimir Putin of having no genuine interest in negotiations. He also criticised a US deal involving Russian diesel, arguing that easing restrictions could allow Moscow to reap financial benefits and pave the way for broader sanctions relief. Watch the replay.

elections.title: Alberta separatists say they'll keep fighting after independence vote
elections.description: One of Alberta’s leading separatists has vowed to continue the independence movement even if voters reject a proposal Monday to begin the process of leaving Canada

elections.title: Pro-Western opposition wins big in Czech Senate election, dealing a blow to populist PM Babiš
elections.description: Pro-Western opposition parties have won big in the Czech Republic's vote for one-third of the seats in Parliament’s upper house, the Senate, dealing a blow to Prime Minister Andrej Babiš's ruling coalition

elections.title: Atlanta’s iconic tavern marks Georgia’s past with an eye on future as midterms approach
elections.description: Since it was established in 1956, Manuel’s Tavern in Atlanta has hosted legendary Democratic leaders while its founder played a key role in the city’s move from a Republican to Democratic stronghold. With the state’s Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff leading the polls in the midterms amid rumours of a future presidential run, the tavern is once more at the heart of the political action.

elections.title: ‘Standing up for democracy’: Atlanta ‘No Kings’ rally draws Trump critics ahead of midterms
elections.description: “No Kings, Vote Now” was the theme of a rally in Atlanta, one of many organised across the US on Saturday. While many demonstrators denounced US President Donald Trump’s policies, organisers said the rally was aimed at getting out the vote in the November 3 midterm elections and protecting democracy in America.

elections.title: Indian YouTuber Dhruv Rathee leads anti-BJP protest in London
elections.description: Dhruv Rathee led a ‘Stop vote theft’ protest in London, accusing Modi's government of electoral manipulation.
